title: Keep a custom Razor tool constructing and reading generated documents
goal: Rebuild a version-coupled Razor compiler host while preserving generated text, diagnostics and source mappings; distinguish optional source defaults from binary constructor compatibility.

selectionNotes: Advanced SDK compiler integration; exact matching compiler/Roslyn closure.
Older public output reader unavailable; verification-only reflection is explicitly separated from supported consumer code.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Execute the current SDK compiler host on its matching runtime family.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: This advanced sample directly references this SDK compiler and matching Roslyn/utility closure; another toolset needs source and binary requalification.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared canonical language mode; no C#15-only syntax is required.

packageAssets: SDK Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Razor.Compiler and Microsoft.AspNetCore.Razor.Utilities.Shared from source-generators, plus Microsoft.CodeAnalysis and CSharp from the same SDK Roslyn/bincore. No Razor.Language 6.0 helper or independent NuGet compiler substitution.
platforms: Managed SDK compiler host; measured Windows x64. No native assets or workloads.
renderingModes: Compiler generation only; no browser, MVC runtime view rendering or IDE-host claim.
prerequisites: A version-coupled custom compiler integration; preserve the complete matching SDK dependency set. Older comparison consumes host-supplied generated documents because this exact older SDK has no public output reader.
constraints: The older SDK internal reader is observed only in the verification harness; it is not a supported or taught consumer route.
Declaration/stub flags label a constructed document; setting them does not generate a declaration or stub.
Retain compiler-produced mapping coordinates as supplied; they are not assumed to map identical text spans.
Optional parameters preserve a recompiled source call, not the previous compiled constructor reference.
stabilityLimitations: GA-targeted 11.0 guidance, actual RC2 compiler 11.1.0-preview.26504.105. Direct SDK-tooling integration is version coupled; no general supported ABI, IDE, older-target or GA guarantee.

evidence.scope: Actual matching SDK dependency compilation; real valid/invalid Razor pipeline text/diagnostics/mapping preservation, current optional choices and previous compiled constructor binding. Older internal reader is verification-only, never a supported consumer interface.
